description: Derive the double-entry ledger for one period in ONE currency from the invoice, credit note, deposit, expense, bank and asset stores, and register it. Nothing is written back. Free: 3 periods a month.

currency.description: Needed when the period holds documents in more than one currency. Currencies are never added together

from.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD

to.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive

name: ledger_build
title: Build the ledger for a period
